text.tspan: store · chain gate · fold · sync driver

div.p: Built today: one node (cairnd) reached over HTTP+SSE; browser runs a parallel TS port. Target: transport/ interface + Node abstraction so BLE/mesh plug in; symmetric node-to-node sync; browser becomes a Go-WASM node (retires the TS port). Browsers never do BLE/mesh — they reach the mesh through a permanent or mobile node.

g.text: full peer — signs, folds, syncs offline
